verdict.rationale: Docs describe a Call History view with performance metrics, recordings, transcripts and raw execution data, plus an Analytics tab for webhooks, call summaries, and extractions — indicating built-in dashboards rather than requiring custom tooling. However, no explicit mention of sentiment scoring or aggregate success-rate reporting across calls is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit sentiment analysis feature, explicit success-rate/outcome aggregation dashboards, independent/hands-on confirmation of dashboard usability.
